Election Commission Addresses Reports of Internal Friction

The Election Commission of India (ECI) has responded to reports of internal friction among its commissioners, stating that differing views and observations are a normal part of deliberation within any institution. The ECI clarified that highlighting specific internal notes over a 10-month period, while overlooking a larger body of approvals and decisions, presents an incomplete picture. The commission rejected claims of an internal rift, asserting that suggestions made by commissioners were aimed at improving the electoral process. However, some reports indicated dissent notes flagging issues such as mass deletions and bypassed rules, suggesting an internal rift.
